stem.text: A barrel of mass $50\,\text{kg}$ is loaded onto the back of a lorry $1.6\,\text{m}$ high by pushing it up a frictionless plank $3.4\,\text{m}$ long.

stem.alt: Diagram of a barrel on the ground at the foot of an inclined plank that rests on the back of a lorry. The plank is labelled 3.4 m along its length and the height of the lorry is labelled 1.6 m. The barrel is labelled barrel mass = 50 kg and the lorry is labelled lorry.
